ATROPHY.name: Atrophy
ATROPHY.flavor: As the body wanes, thoughts becomes heavy.

OCEANS_DESCENT.name: Oceans' Descent
OCEANS_DESCENT.flavor: All will be crushed beneath the tides.

TWIN_HEADED_OUROBOROS.name: Twin-Headed Ouroboros
TWIN_HEADED_OUROBOROS.desc:
On Your First Turn, when you activate an ability, Copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.
On Your Last Turn, when you activate an ability, Counter it.

BOW_OF_BELLS_END.name: Bow of Bell's End
BOW_OF_BELLS_END.desc:
On Your First Turn, Skip that turn.
On Your Last Turn, take and Additional Turn after that.

BUCKET_BRIM_CRUSTACEAN.name: Bucket Brim Crustacean
BUCKET_BRIM_CRUSTACEAN.desc: When you would lose Spin on your Turn, %d%% chance to gain that much instead.

PREOWNED_LOOP.name: Preowned Loop
PREOWNED_LOOP.desc: At the start each Round, Choose an Opponent's Coin Piece and activate a Copy of its ability.

CIRCLE_OF_LEECHES.name: Circle of Leeches
CIRCLE_OF_LEECHES.desc:
After an ability of a Coin Piece you own is activated, Add a %s to it.
After a %s is removed from a Coin Piece you own, add a %s to it.

BLACK_SULFUR.name: Black Sulfur Seal
BLACK_SULFUR.desc: At the start of your turn, lose %d Spin.

LEAD.name: Lead Seal
LEAD.desc: The next time an ability of this Coin Piece would be activated, Counter that activation and Remove this Seal.

CLEANSING.name: Cleansing Seal
CLEANSING.desc: At the end of your turn, remove this and all adjacent Seals.

QUICKSILVER.name: Quicksilver Seal
QUICKSILVER.desc: After an ability of this Coin Piece is activated, lose %d Spin.

MOCK.name: Mock Ability
MOCK.desc: Add a %s to target Coin Piece.

MOCK_SEAL.name: Mock Seal
MOCK_SEAL.desc: Remove the Seal from target Coin Piece.

STOPPAGE.name: Stoppage
STOPPAGE.desc: Add a %s to target Coin Piece.

DRAG_UNDER.name: Drag Under
DRAG_UNDER.desc: Opponent loses Spin equal to half the difference between yours'.

HESITANCE.name: Hesitance
HESITANCE.desc: Add a %s to target Coin Piece.
